composition: scripts/run_msnl_eval.py mc_engine_outcome, unchanged, from an OPEN and a PARTIAL prior at each case's served index, plus the existing addresses_gap and assess_response signals; offline and network-free.
interface_differences: Inputs: the incumbent reads the current answer, the gap type and (for serving only) the served question; it never reads the original idea or the preceding answer. The candidate reads all four texts.

Output: the incumbent yields ONE decision, whether the answer advanced the gap or set the known mechanism; the candidate yields two independent axes (project_relation, new_contribution), a possible_amendment disclosure and a grounded evidence quote.
No relation axis, no novelty axis, no abstention: F3 (over-abstention) and F4 (relation flip) have no incumbent counterpart, and no M-AMEND reading exists.

The comparison here is decision against frozen slot label only: false credit = the incumbent credits a case whose frozen label is not (RELATED, CONTENT_BEARING); false rejection = it does not credit a case whose frozen label is (RELATED, CONTENT_BEARING). It is not method equivalence and not an F1-F4 verdict.
The incumbent reads only the prior answer's quality, never its content, so the PARTIAL prior's placeholder text cannot change a relevance decision; both priors are measured and reported.
limits: synthetic, author-chosen clear cases (blind-label agreement 120 of 120): not a real-user failure rate
Mechanism Completeness questions only, two domains, six projects, one preceding answer per case
English and Modern Standard Arabic only; no dialect
a fresh offline state per case: the live journey's W2-C serving adjustments, UQTR suppression and need routing are not exercised
it qualifies, rejects or ranks no method and says nothing about the candidate, which has no valid run
status: SYNTHETIC — OFFLINE INCUMBENT BASELINE; no provider request
